chunks.title: Risks for hedgefunds
chunks.text: A typical hedge fund develops methods to find stocks they think will perform well. The informational edge that they're seeking is usually market relative, meaning they're looking for stocks that will go up more than the market if the market goes up, or stocks that will go down less than the market if the market goes down. If this information they have is reliable, they can take advantage of the CAPM
